profile.title: Senior Software Architect
profile.bio: Over 10 years of experience in Angular development, client-side optimization, and designing real-time system architectures with absolute performance. Expert in advanced UI/UX integration and portal security systems.

details: Designed next-generation Angular architecture for real-time financial charting systems.
Optimized Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) by 40%, reduced bundle size by 30%.
Trained development team, built a design system based on Tailwind CSS v4.
Developed Web applications to control IoT devices via Canvas 2D/3D.
Built reusable Angular custom elements for micro-frontend systems.
Optimized complex RxJS data stream processing pipelines.
Built Dashboard administration page for Big Data.
Developed and maintained APIs written in Express, PostgreSQL database.
Designed data pagination and caching solutions on the client-side.
